82111: Haruki is a teenage boy of average height with unkempt black hair and bangs that fall above his attentive grey eyes.
82115: Setsuna is a third year student at Houjou High. She has been Miss Houjou two years in a row and enjoys singing karaoke. Setsuna likes singing "White Album", a song from the first White Album visual novel.
82119: Kazusa is a third year student at Houjou High and is in the same class as Haruki Kitahara. She often dozes off in, is late for, or skips class. She is a very talented pianist, and comes from a wealthy family.
88017: A world famous pianist, and currently lives in Paris away from her daughter Kazusa. She's stirred the mass media up as much as an entertainer ever since she was young with her unrestrained lifestyle. She's divorced twice, but it's not certain who Kazusa's father is.
88018: Setsuna's younger brother who's three years younger. Even though his sister always gets prioritized at home, he doesn't seem to mind that. He's big-hearted, honest, and cares a lot for his family.
88019: A student of Class 3-A at Houjou University Attached High School. She's the former captain of the basketball team. She's classmates with Setsuna, as well as Haruki's friend, and she's known Takeya for a while.
88020: A student of 3-G at Houjou University Attached High School. He's Haruki's best friend and president of the light music club. He's better at the guitar than Haruki. His loose looks and speech give birth to rumors that he has a girlfriend in each class, but the truth is unknown.
88021: A student of Class 3-E at Houjou University Attached High School. He's one of Haruki's classmates and a close friend. He's working himself to the bone trying to make the school festival a success... or so he acts while relying on Haruki all the time and enjoying himself.
261178: Izumi is a constantly slacking problem student that Haruki Kitahara can’t help but look after. She is a woman who doesn’t act like one and a friendly girl who doesn’t seem to be caught up in any drama.
263210: Competitor for the title of Miss Houjou and rival of Setsuna, as well as former Houjou Light Music club member.
